description: React component for displaying and handling user acceptance/rejection of Terms of Service in Mattermost, including fetching TOS data, user actions, and rendering UI elements.

classes.name: TermsOfService
classes.description: React component managing the display and user interaction with Terms of Service, including fetching TOS data, handling accept/reject actions, and rendering the UI.

methods.name: getTermsOfService
methods.description: Fetches the Terms of Service data from the server and updates component state.

methods.name: handleLogoutClick
methods.description: Handles user logout action triggered by clicking the logout link.

methods.name: handleAcceptTerms
methods.description: Handles user acceptance of Terms of Service, updates server, and redirects accordingly.

methods.name: handleRejectTerms
methods.description: Handles user rejection of Terms of Service, updates server, and logs out user.

methods.name: registerUserAction
methods.description: Sends acceptance/rejection of TOS to server and handles response, including error display.
